displayName: Supplier Compliance Check（医械供应商合规核查）
description: Supplier compliance check for medical device manufacturers: it walks through qualifying and re-qualifying suppliers — collecting licences and certificates, checking QMS status, auditing critical vendors and recording the evidence. Supplier compliance check for medical device manufacturers: it walks through qualifying and re-qualifying suppliers — collecting licences and certificates, checking QMS status, auditing critical vendors and recording the evidence. Produces a per-supplier checklist and a risk ranking so purchasing and quality teams know which vendors need an on-site audit first. Use when onboarding a new component supplier or re-reviewing the existing supplier list. 核查医疗器械原材料/组件供应商合规：ISO 13485 证书、材质证明（金属牌号/检测报告）、ROHS·REACH 符合性、UDI 供应链穿透。输出供应商合规台账与缺口清单。生成后建议用 medical-device-compliance-grader 的 C4 维度自测。
